SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_NAME name, FINPROD_ID hidCode, FINPROD_NAME shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%') OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%')))

SELECT DISTINCT CASH_OUT_NO id, CASH_OUT_NO text FROM INTERF_CREDIT_ITEM_INFO
CASH_OUT_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%')
SELECT REL_CONTRACT_NO cmsContractId, BECIF cmsBecif, APROVE_AMOUNT issueAmt FROM INTERF_CREDIT_ITEM_INFO WHERE CASH_OUT_NO = #{cmsId}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND( CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') OR CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE IS_TRUSTER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND( CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') OR CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT CALENDAR_ID id, CALENDAR_NAME text FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO
CALENDAR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.MANAGER manager, A.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.ISSUER issuer, A.REMARK remark,
A.CONTRACT_NO contractNo,
/*(CASE WHEN B.PUR_SPEED = 0 THEN '01' WHEN B.PUR_SPEED = 1 THEN '02' ELSE '03' END) transMode,*/ B.PUR_SPEED, B.RED_SPEED, B.IS_OPEN_EVERYDAY isOpenEveryDay,
B.CREDIT_ENHANCE_MEASURE creditEnhanceMeasure, B.FUND_MANGER_NAME fundMangerName, C.CASH_OUT_NO cmsId, D.TYPE_6 category, D.TYPE_7 type,
D.TYPE_9 type9, D.TYPE_10 type10, D.TYPE_11 type11, D.TYPE_12 type12,
T.PFLSH pflsh, T.HAP_CREDIT_AMT hapCreditAmt, T.CREDIT_FLAG creditFlag, C.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID actualCreditProvid, C.INVESTMENT_ATTRIBUTES investmentAttributes,
C.ACTUAL_MANAGER actualManager,
C.TRIAL_NO trialNo, C.BASE_RULE baseRule, C.OVERALLOCATION overallocation, G.WARN_LINE warnLine, G.FLAT_LINE flatLine,
REP_ASSET_DEPT.REP_ASSET_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B,PA_FIN_PRODUCT C,FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN (SELECT T2.FINPROD_ID,T1.CREDIT_FLAG,T1.PFLSH,T1.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T1.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES T1 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T2 ON T2.SEQNO = T1.CUSTOMER_ID) T ON (T.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID OR T.CUSTOMER_ID = A.FINPROD_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND E.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE F ON F.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID AND F.EFF_DATE = A.VDATE
LEFT JOIN FIN_POST_INVEST_INFO G ON A.FINPROD_ID = G.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT REP_ASSET_DEPT on A.FINPROD_ID = REP_ASSET_DEPT.REP_FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT A.REP_ASSET_TYPE repAssetType, A.REP_TRADE_MARKET repTradeMarket, B.REP_PARTY_CODE repPartyCode, B.REP_REGIST_CODE repRegistCode, B.REP_AMT repAmt, B.REP_CAPI_INVEST repCapiInvest, B.REP_CAP_USE_WAY repCapUseWay, B.REP_CAP_USE_INDU repCapUseIndu, B.REP_CAP_USE_INDU_LEVEL2 repCapUseInduLevel2, B.REP_PLAN_PROP repPlanProp, B.REP_YIELD_FLAG repYieldFlag, B.REP_MAX_RATE repMaxRate, B.REP_MIN_RATE repMinRate, B.REP_BUY_STRUCT repBuyStruct, B.REP_MANAGE_TYPE repManageType, B.REP_IS_CTRL_BOTTOM repIsCtrlBottom, B.REP_MGR_FEE_RATE repMgrFeeRate, B.REP_TRU_FEE_RATE repTruFeeRate, B.REP_TRADE_FEE_RATE repTradeFeeRate, B.REP_AGENCY_FEE_RATE repAgencyFeeRate, B.REP_OTHER_FEE_RATE repOtherFeeRate, B.REP_REMARK repRemark, B.REP_FINANCIAL_COMISSUE repFinancialComissue,
C.REP_PRIVATEPRD_FLAG repPrivateprdFlag,
C.REP_PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,C.REP_PPPFLAG,C.REP_SMALLCREDIT,C.REP_BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG FROM REP_ASSET_MNG_PLAN B, REP_ASSET_DEPT A
LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_OTHER C ON A.REP_FINPROD_ID = C.REP_FINPROD_ID
WHERE A.REP_FINPROD_ID = B.REP_FINPROD_ID AND A.REP_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT A.REP_ASSET_TYPE repAssetType, A.REP_TRADE_MARKET repTradeMarket, B.REP_TRUSTEE repTrustee, B.REP_ENTRUST_INVEST_MONEY repEntrustInvestMoney, B.REP_CAPI_INVEST repCapiInvest, B.REP_APPLICATION_MODE repApplicationMode, B.REP_CAP_USE_INDU repCapUseIndu, B.REP_CAP_USE_INDU_LEVEL2 repCapUseInduLevel2, B.REP_TRUST_INVEST_ATTRIBUTE repTrustInvestAttribute, B.REP_CONTAIN_EXPECTED_YIELD repContainExpectedYield, B.REP_MAX_EXPECTED_YIELD repMaxExpectedYield, B.REP_MIN_EXPECTED_YIELD repMinExpectedYield, B.REP_MANAGEMENT_RATE repManagementRate, B.REP_TRUST_RATE repTrustRate, B.REP_TRADE_SUM_RATE repTradeSumRate, B.REP_INTERMEDIARY_SUM_RATE repIntermediarySumRate, B.REP_OTHER_SUM_RATE repOtherSumRate, B.REP_REMARK repRemark,
C.REP_PRIVATEPRD_FLAG repPrivateprdFlag
FROM REP_TRUST_INVEST_MODE B, REP_ASSET_DEPT A
LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_OTHER C ON A.REP_FINPROD_ID = C.REP_FINPROD_ID
WHERE A.REP_FINPROD_ID = B.REP_FINPROD_ID AND A.REP_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{custormId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
